messages:
mike: Hi finance - got a bar tab on the team dinner that only has a single undetailed invoice from the venue (no itemization). Paid on personal card. Uploaded pic of the invoice to Ramp: https://ramp.app/receipts/bar-invoice-179888 (image attached). Filing as 'Team dinner - personal card'.

olivia: quick q - does the invoice show total and date? we need either an itemized receipt or attendee list plus manager approval for non-itemized group charges.

mike: invoice shows date, total $420, and 'event charge'. no breakdown per person or alcohol line items.

taylor: i managed the dinner. confirming attendees: Mike, Olivia, Jamal, Priya (4 people). Manager Taylor approves reimbursing meal portion but alcohol needs itemized proof per policy. we can reimburse up to per-person meal cap.

expenses-bot: Policy reminder: For group meals under $75 per person with a non-itemized invoice, finance requires manager attestation listing attendees and which line items were alcohol vs food. If itemization cannot be obtained, finance will reimburse reasonable meal portion up to policy caps and deny alcohol if not verifiable.

mike: attached a short note from Taylor in Ramp: "Attendees: Mike, Olivia, Jamal, Priya. Total covers food + wine; please reimburse meal up to $75/person. Alcohol not verified." Resubmitted.

olivia: can you split the Ramp line into 4 people and tag as 'team dinner - share'?

expenses-bot: Received manager attestation. Finance will process reimbursement for food portion = min(total minus estimated alcohol, policy cap) across 4 people. Please allow 5 business days.

mike: thanks all :thumbsup:
